rule: Route by intended function first; exact model, technology and engineering come later.

routes.label: Glamping / resort accommodation
routes.why: Repeatable guest/hospitality product system from compact units to large resort spaces.

routes.label: Permanent or seasonal home
routes.why: Residential planning, household program, comfort and project/permit route are the primary drivers.

routes.label: Office / HQ / public glass building
routes.why: Building-grade aluminium-glass or glass-composite architecture with facade/energy/MEP engineering.

routes.label: School / outdoor classroom / learning space
routes.why: Education-specific product identity with membrane/transparent and separate glass EDU branches.

routes.label: Cover an existing house, yard or modular complex
routes.why: The dome acts as a protective environmental enclosure around/above another object.

routes.label: Monolithic / shotcrete residence or retreat
routes.why: Continuous concrete/shotcrete shell with waterproofing, drainage and landscape integration logic.

routes.label: Small pod / tree / lakefront capsule
routes.why: Compact approximately Ø3 m / 7 m² configurable capsule ecosystem.

routes.label: Immersive attraction / 360×180 experience
routes.why: Physical + digital visitor platform with content, control and operator workflow.

routes.label: Natural / reed-clad dome-home direction
routes.why: Public directional family; current specialist pack must be locked before exact technical routing.

routes.label: Greenhouse / agriculture / BIO
routes.why: Routing direction only; material, climate and cultivation system are project-specific.

boundary: This router does not select a final structural model, approve permits, calculate loads or create a binding price.
